description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git pack-object' functionality within the Git project. It contains setup procedures, various test cases, and utility functions to verify pack and unpack processes, delta compression, object verification, and related features in Git. The script employs standard shell scripting and Git commands to run automated tests and checks for correctness and robustness.
external_files: list of pack files such as 'pack-object-stdin', 'test-1-*.pack', etc.

methods.name: check_deltas
methods.description: Utility function to parse and verify the number of delta objects reported in stderr output from pack-objects.

methods.name: check_use_objects
methods.description: Function to verify that packed objects can be correctly unpacked and match expected object data.

methods.name: test_with_bad_commit
methods.description: Function to test index-pack behavior with faulty commit objects under different options.
